result.quote: “Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?”
result.reason: Verse 7:19 gives exactly this as the officer’s statement to the man of God, whom the continuation identifies as Elisha. The key is fully supported and uniquely answers the natural, specific question. Changing “captain” to “officer” and present tense to past tense preserves the original fact and answer scope.
